Formed in 1928, it has had brief stints in the [[Nemzeti Bajnokság III]]. It set to play in the [[Nemzeti Bajnokság I]] from 2024–25 after promotion from [[Nemzeti Bajnokság II]] in 2023–24. The team is locally referred to by its monicker, ''Szpari''. Its games take place in [[Városi Stadion (Nyíregyháza)|Városi Stadion]], in the city sport complex just north of the downtown. {{See also|2025–26 Nyíregyháza Spartacus FC season}}"}}
